model.title: To provide for the transfer of administrative jurisdiction over certain Federal land in the State of California, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Tom McClintock (R-CA)

summary.text: The bill would swap administrative control of certain parcels of federal land between Yosemite National Park and Stanislaus National Forest in California. This transfer would allow land currently used for cattle grazing to be managed by the Forest Service, which permits grazing as part of its multiple-use management approach, rather than by the National Park Service.
